bug_semantics: An authenticated Contributor who can create or edit a mep_events post can persist quote-bearing payloads in event venue, street, city, state, postcode, country, and related registration-label metadata. strip_tags() in the original save path and sanitize_text_field() in later releases do not provide output-context encoding. The stored values were returned raw and inserted into quoted HTML attributes and URL-related output, allowing an attacker-controlled quote to terminate an attribute and inject executable markup when the affected event or edit surface is rendered.
flaw_origin: The assigned GitHub clone begins at parentless commit 644782aed278644a141d8d29ea5edfb4311ffad9, a 111-file, 22,394-line version-3.2.3 snapshot, so that aggregate import is rejected as the BIC. First-party WordPress SVN history resolves the earlier boundary: revision r1815482 first added inc/mep_event_meta.php in the version-1.0 initial release, including both strip_tags()-based storage of the six location fields and direct unescaped echoes into quoted value attributes. The corresponding SVN-to-Git history commit is 88a25a962d233d10851138f11d62b0b3160a9020; its immediate parent 213cf47c76e05bb53d991129340561634a4fe40b has the empty tree and lacks both inc/mep_event_meta.php and woocommerce-event-press.php.
ai_marker: absent: `git cat-file commit 88a25a962d233d10851138f11d62b0b3160a9020` shows author and committer magepeopleteam <magepeopleteam@b8457f37-d9ea-0310-8a92-e5e31aec5664> and the message `Initial release of mage woo event booking manager`, with no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, AI trailer, or other AI evidence in the BIC commit object.
evidence: Disagreement resolved: the primary reported NOT_AI with BIC 88a25a962d233d10851138f11d62b0b3160a9020, parent 213cf47c76e05bb53d991129340561634a4fe40b, and parent absence true; the reviewer reported BLOCKED with null introducer fields because it stopped at the GitHub root aggregate. Re-running `git show -s --format='%H%n%P%n%s' 644782aed278644a141d8d29ea5edfb4311ffad9`, `git show --shortstat`, and `git grep -n 'Version:'` in the assigned clone proves that boundary is parentless, adds 111 files/22,394 lines, and already labels the plugin 3.2.3, so neither audit may use it as the BIC. First-party `PROPFIND https://plugins.svn.wordpress.org/!svn/rvr/1815482/mage-eventpress/trunk/inc/mep_event_meta.php` returns revision 1815482, author magepeopleteam, timestamp 2018-02-05T07:05:26.156370Z, and the WordPress repository UUID; fetching the same path at r1815481 returns HTTP 404. In the SVN-to-Git mirror, `git log --all --reverse --diff-filter=A -- inc/mep_event_meta.php` returns only 88a25a962d233d10851138f11d62b0b3160a9020; `git diff-tree --name-status` reports inc/mep_event_meta.php and woocommerce-event-press.php as added; `git ls-tree -r --name-only 213cf47c76e05bb53d991129340561634a4fe40b -- inc/mep_event_meta.php woocommerce-event-press.php` is empty; and the parent commit object points to Git's empty-tree hash. `git grep` at the BIC shows lines 27-62 directly echoing the six metadata values into single-quoted value attributes, lines 127-132 using strip_tags() on POST values, and lines 140-145 persisting them; the plugin header is Version 1.0. Thus the primary wins all four assigned disputes and the reviewer's claimed prehistory gap is disproved by the first-party SVN lineage and its direct parent. Fix/version gate: `git show --patch c6f8d3233087881d3eb7ed3ebe9a6ebc7795f144` adds esc_html() to the location helper and esc_attr() to registration labels; merge 7d59237ae8ae6e0f264791adb92e7352bcc81de8 has that direct fix as its second parent; `git show --patch 071468739aa98faa528c387d300d67aa68eb2966` escapes remaining raw location reads and changes the plugin header from 4.4.2 to 4.4.3, matching the advisory's affected-through-4.4.2 boundary. The clone has no Git tags.
reasoning: The vulnerability is an output-context escaping failure: tag stripping or text sanitization does not neutralize quote characters before attacker-controlled metadata reaches HTML attribute contexts. The GitHub root is a later aggregate and cannot establish origin, but it also does not make the case blocked because the plugin's first-party SVN lineage is available. SVN r1815482 is the smallest real change that first writes the vulnerable save-and-render mechanism: it adds the relevant file in the initial version-1.0 release, while the directly preceding revision and the corresponding immediate Git parent lack the plugin source. This is an addition, not a move, refactor, revert, or later snapshot import. The primary is therefore correct and the reviewer is wrong on verdict, introducer_sha, introducer_parent, and parent_absence. Attribution uses only that verified BIC commit object, whose human/team identity and plain initial-release message contain no AI signal, so the gate-complete verdict is NOT_AI. The advisory-referenced c6f8d3233087881d3eb7ed3ebe9a6ebc7795f144 is the direct code fix; 071468739aa98faa528c387d300d67aa68eb2966 completes remaining location escaping and establishes the patched 4.4.3 release boundary.
